newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market slow, no trade - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market slow, no trade - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared to Friday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow. Demand and seller interest light to very light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) compared Friday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, with a lower undertone noted.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1225-1250 lbs couple lds 108.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 104.00-105.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 106.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 100.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
